query_analysis.original_query: For a counter-current liquid-liquid extraction unitA gas-liquid system operates in a spray column under steady-state conditions. Derive a differential equation that relates the concentration gradient to the height of the column, assuming film theory., describe how mass transfer equilibrium impacts the design of multiple extraction stages.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Derive a differential equation for a counter-current liquid-liquid extraction process in a spray column, relating concentration gradient to column height under steady-state conditions, and explain the influence of mass transfer equilibrium on the design of multiple extraction stages.
